name: Be right back
description: Full-frame break card on a calm, slowly drifting gradient: title, subtitle and an optional countdown.

params.name: subtitle
params.help: Line under it, e.g. Short break, back in five minutes (empty: none)

params.name: duration
params.help: Count down this long from when it is shown or the value changes (seconds or m:ss; 0: no countdown)

example.title: Be right back
example.subtitle: Short break, we continue in a few minutes
